about.title: About CG-NET
about.subtitle: Myanmar's trusted internet service provider since 2015
about.tagline: We are dedicated to providing reliable, high-speed internet services to homes and businesses.
about.mission: Our mission is to connect you to what matters most through seamless online experiences, cutting-edge technology, and exceptional customer service.
about.vision: Our vision is to be the leading internet service provider known for our customer-centric approach and cutting-edge technology. We aim to empower communities by ensuring everyone has access to fast and reliable internet, bridging the digital divide and fostering a connected world.
about.storyText1: Founded in 2014, Chen Guang WiFi has grown to become a trusted name in the internet service industry. We are a team of passionate professionals committed to bringing the best internet solutions to our customers. With our extensive network and innovative technology, we strive to deliver superior connectivity and support.
about.storyText2: With over a decade of experience, a strong local presence, and more than 6 branch offices, we’ve built a reputation for dependable service and community trust.
about.cultureDescription: Beyond our technical duties, our team thrives on regular collaborative workshops, skill-sharing sessions, and engaging company events that build strong bonds and drive collective success.
